intro-sections.title: PREMIUM QUALITY GUARANTEED
intro-sections.content:
## Lab-Tested Products

Every product in our dispensary undergoes rigorous testing to ensure safety, potency, and purity. We partner with licensed laboratories to provide you with detailed cannabinoid profiles and safety information.

### What We Test For:
- **Potency** - Accurate THC/CBD levels
- **Pesticides** - Ensuring product safety
- **Heavy Metals** - Clean, pure products
- **Microbials** - Safe consumption
